items.idiom: there is nothing better to do
items.example: I use social media when there is nothing better to do.
I am amazed by how much useful information you can find.
Social media is a good way to keep in touch with friends.
We chat about the latest music and play games online.
They play games with each other after school.
Young people use technology to change the world.
Social media helps young people organise political change.
